entries.03ec6d7d9555d6c5: Customers for meat and chicken eggs
entries.9e7a17653fe2dad2: This business purchases, processes and sells meat and chicken eggs. Subsidiaries Feed One Foods, Yokohama Meat, Magic Pearl and Gold Egg are in charge.
entries.9fa21aa407057b07: General customers such as aquaculture operators
entries.ab6d33a22f4d6701: This business manufactures and sells compound feed for cattle, pigs, chickens and other livestock, and is the core of the company. The group also includes livestock companies that raise pigs and sell chicken eggs. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 accounted for the large majority of the company's total and decreased 3.7% from the previous year. This was because sales volume and average selling price were below the previous year.
entries.b0788cb8cbabed9a: This is a category not included in reportable segments, covering real estate leasing and overseas business. Overseas, affiliates KYODO SOJITZ FEED COMPANY LIMITED (Vietnam) and NIPPAI SHALIMAR FEEDS PRIVATE LIMITED (India) manufacture and sell feed. Revenue from external customers is printed as ¥13 million, a very small amount compared with the other categories.
entries.b7d684a205a1f697: A company that makes compound feed for cattle, pigs, chickens, fish, and other animals and sells it to farmers and aquaculture operators, and also handles meat and chicken eggs.
entries.debcb92e804ecc65: This business manufactures and sells compound feed for farmed fish. It also purchases and sells marine products, and its subsidiary Nan'yo Gyogyo conducts aquaculture to research the company's feed. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 decreased 3.0% from the previous year. This was because sales volume and average selling price were below the previous year.
